```json
{"claims":[{"claim_text":"The COVID-19 pandemic has killed hundreds of thousands of people in the United States.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The COVID-19 pandemic exposed America’s massive racial and economic health disparities.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Free healthcare for all is necessary, according to the assessment of the pandemic’s effects.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"State-sanctioned police violence, socio-economic and environmental factors, and co-morbidities rooted in the for-profit healthcare system account for the disproportionate deaths from illness and disease including COVID-19 among Black and Indigenous people in the United States.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"National oppression, racism, and colonialism exacerbate the consequences of the pandemic for the Global South.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Medicare for All redirects resources and establishes healthcare as a public good.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Medicare for All provides a model for a society based on solidarity and caregiving.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Food insecurity, environmental racism, mass incarceration, police violence, and the violence of mass detention of immigrants must all be addressed as interlocking public health crises.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"A comprehensive, transformative response is needed to address food insecurity, environmental racism, mass incarceration, police violence, and the violence of mass detention of immigrants.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"A culturally competent healthcare system should listen to, honor, and respond to the experience of Black and brown patients.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
